claims.statement: In Poland, a holder cancels a GO through the TGE registry and TGE confirms cancellation on request; the registry confirmation, not a generic sustainability report, is the appropriate completed event.
EU rules require electronic, accurate, reliable and fraud-resistant issuance, transfer and cancellation, impose transaction validity and expiry timing, and use cancellation for supplier disclosure.
TGE's April 2026 release added bulk transactions and a marketplace, reducing the amount of proprietary value available from simple batching or counterparty discovery.

Polish registry mechanics require an authorized holder or member relationship; bilateral GO contracts and financial settlement are outside TGE, so a non-member operator needs a contractual registry participant.

A valid Scope 2 proof workflow must preserve unique ownership, cancellation on behalf of the reporting entity, vintage, and applicable market boundaries; a site-period allocation ledger can support but cannot override those rules.

Certificate-backed renewable-energy claims carry material wording risk: UOKiK specifically warns that presenting certificate coverage as physical renewable supply without clear limitations may mislead consumers.

Ecohz, Soldera, and Energy Solution already offer substantial portions of the proposed workflow, including procurement, allocation, cancellation, proof storage, multi-entity status, or Polish TGE certificate delivery.
The candidate's strongest remaining wedge is a narrow Polish white-label exception and evidence layer embedded in brokers' workflows, but broker demand and willingness to delegate are unobserved.
Europex reports 53.219 TWh of Polish GO volume in 2025; 0.5 TWh is about 0.94% and 4 TWh about 7.5% of that reference volume, so the growth plan requires meaningful market share.

The current AIB member page did not provide affirmative evidence of Polish Hub connectivity during this review; current cross-border recognition and automation must be confirmed directly rather than assumed.
Residual-mix accounting exists to prevent double counting of untracked electricity attributes, reinforcing the need for precise consumption-to-certificate allocation and claims wording.
Pricing, channel conversion, exception cost, registry automation access, part-time operating load, and the founder-net-worth path remain unsupported by observed transactions.
No reviewed source proves a fatal condition; authorization can potentially be supplied by a partner, while economics and partner commitment remain uncertain rather than impossible.

contrary_evidence: TGE now supplies bulk transactions and a marketplace within RGP.
Ecohz already aggregates decentralized business-unit purchases, performs cancellation, and stores proof.
Soldera advertises consumption-file upload, multi-country procurement and cancellation planning, hosted accounts, and retirement dashboards.
Energy Solution already performs Polish GO purchase, cancellation, and TGE certificate delivery.
UOKiK enforcement makes claims wording and limitation disclosure a core liability rather than a cosmetic report feature.
The 4 TWh year-six target represents about 7.5% of the reported 2025 Polish GO volume.
